Answer ID: 12661 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 974/826=D/1430) In order to protect yourself from the trouble, you should recite the following dua 111 times with durood ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) 11 times before and after the dua: حسبنا اللہ ونعم الوکیل Also, keep on reciting یا اللہ، یا رحمن، یا رحیم excessively, in-sha-Allah it will render required results, Allah will grant you honour in both the worlds. For your safety, recite the following dua thrice in the morning and evening: بسم اللہ الذي لایضر مع اسمہ شئ في الأرض ولا في السماء وھو السمیع العلیم You should contact your husband and convince him to take you to his house. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
